The Cadbury Clutch: A Sparkling Take on Generosity
Dressed in the brand's unmistakable jewel-tone purple, the

Clutch sparkles with gold accents and individually applied Swarovski crystals. Its crystal-covered flap took approximately eight hours to complete, while a concealed platinum-silver insulated interior helps keep

chocolate cool and ready for an unexpected moment of generosity. Only five clutches have been created, making each one a rare little reminder that sharing chocolate can be every bit as glamorous as it is delicious.

"From the silhouette and color to the hand-applied crystals, every element feels intentional and true to both brands. It is bold and beautifully crafted, but designed to be opened and shared."
The clutch is just the beginning. Through "There's Magic in More,"
is celebrating the delightful difference a little extra can make. A little more thought. A little more generosity. And, naturally, a little more chocolate. For generations,

has been known for bringing a little more to every bite, from its signature creamy chocolate to generous ingredients crafted for sharing. "There's Magic in More" builds on that heritage, celebrating the idea that the same spirit of generosity found in
chocolate can inspire meaningful connections every day. Watch the 30-second Department of More hero film

Consumers will meet the wonderfully dedicated people behind every creamy bite through cinematic storytelling, social experiences and unexpected cultural moments – from ingredient specialists and chocolate makers to those entrusted with the very important responsibility of taste-testing. Together, their stories show how the brand's care, craft and generous spirit can turn an ordinary moment into something magical. The first chapter of "There's Magic in More" invites consumers into the Department of More, a world where thoughtful gestures, generous spirits and a shared piece of chocolate can spark something unexpectedly magical.
